summary: Completed frontend testing for FortexaRH translation fixes. All 5 requested features PASSED: MetricsDashboard months translate correctly (Ene→Jan in EN, Ene in ES), chart and table show consistent month translations, Employee form tabs display correctly in selected language, PayrollV2 payroll types are translated correctly, language switching updates all components.

issues: Some chart titles are hardcoded in Spanish: 'Comparativa Año vs Año', 'Proyección de Gastos', 'Análisis de Rotación de Personal', 'KPIs de Rotación'

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add i18n translations for hardcoded Spanish strings in MetricsDashboard Advanced Analytics section (lines 631, 683, 719, 732, 736, 757, 787, 791, 806)
critical_code_review_comments: translateMonth() function correctly maps Spanish month abbreviations (Ene, Feb, Mar...) to i18n keys
Month abbreviation keys properly added to all locale JSON files (en.json, es.json, fr.json)
payrollTrend data is pre-translated before rendering in charts and tables
Language switching works correctly across all tested pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Translation fixes for MetricsDashboard months, Employee form tabs, and PayrollV2 types are complete and working. The translateMonth() function in MetricsDashboardPage.jsx correctly translates Spanish month abbreviations to the selected language. Some hardcoded Spanish strings remain in the Advanced Analytics section but these were not part of the original bug report.

metrics_dashboard_months_en.details: MetricsDashboard displays English month abbreviations (Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec) when language is set to English. Chart X-axis and table rows show correct translations.

metrics_dashboard_months_es.details: MetricsDashboard displays Spanish month abbreviations (Ene, Feb, Mar, Abr, Mayo, Jun, Jul, Ago, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dic) when language is set to Spanish. Chart X-axis and table rows show correct translations.

metrics_dashboard_table_consistency.details: Monthly comparison table shows consistent month translations matching the chart. Both use the translateMonth() function to convert Spanish month abbreviations to i18n keys.

employee_form_tabs.details: Employee form tabs display correctly in Spanish: 'Datos Principales', 'Contrato', 'Descuentos', 'Documentos', 'Forma de Pago', 'Contacto de Emergencia'. All 6 tabs found and translated.

payroll_v2_types.details: PayrollV2 page shows Spanish payroll types: 'Regular', 'Temporal', 'Bono/Extraordinaria'. Page title 'Gestión de Nómina' and tabs 'Dashboard', 'Períodos', 'Hoja de Nómina', 'Aprobación', 'Reportes' all translated.

language_switching.details: Language switching works correctly. Tested EN→ES and ES→EN switches. All components update immediately including MetricsDashboard months, Employee form tabs, PayrollV2 types, and navigation menu.
